messages:
Zoe: Heads-up: InfraWare (acct IW-59) disputed INV-5299 (May). They claim duplicate charge for a nightly batch run plus an incorrect VAT line. They're asking for a credit and a 60-day split of the remainder.
Marco: Can we get the invoice + raw billing events? need to confirm duplicate POSTs and check VAT jurisdiction.
Zoe: Invoice + events: https://billing.redwood.example/invoices/INV-5299  https://events.redwood.example/iw-59/2026-05
Tanya: CS on call with them: they saw two identical job submissions around 03:00 UTC and one job retried automatically by their queue; they believe we billed both as separate runs. Finance offered to pay 20% today if we issue a partial credit and sign a payment plan.
Pri: Legal: we can do a credit if logs show duplicate server-side retries. Also require dispute withdrawal and a limited release of chargeback rights for credited portion. I'll draft an addendum.
Marco: Quick skim: looks like 2 job_ids with same payload submitted by their client within 90s. We billed both since they used unique request IDs. Need to decide whether to credit one run or not; policy says client-side retries are billable unless we can show server duplicate processing.
tax-bot: Tax check: VAT in invoice appears calculated at 20% for UK; customer claims they are EU but exempt with OSS registration. Need VAT id to validate and adjust if necessary.
Luis: Collections: dunning sent 1st_notice earlier. We prefer to get initial payment + signed addendum before pausing escalation. Also ask for payment method confirmation.
Zoe: Proposed resolution: 1) technical review to confirm duplicate server processing -> if confirmed, issue credit for one run (approx $3,200). 2) if VAT proof provided, adjust tax line. 3) accept 60-day payment plan for remaining balance: 20% now, two installments at 30d and 60d. Require signed addendum withdrawing dispute and waiving chargeback for balance covered by plan. No suspension while plan active.
Tanya: InfraWare agreed on the call to provide VAT registration and to send a payment of 20% immediately if we produce the addendum and provisional credit note. They also accepted a soft daily token cap while we finish technical review.
Pri: I'll draft a one-paragraph addendum with dispute withdrawal and chargeback waiver and include condition that credit will be issued only if reconciliation confirms server-side duplicate. Posting draft in #legal-review in 30m.
Marco: Running reconciliation now. If server processed both jobs, credit will not apply; if processing deduped due to idempotency gap we should credit. I'll post findings asap.
collections-bot: Dunning bot: 1st_notice sent to IW-59 for INV-5299 at 2025678906. Next escalation: account hold in 10 days if unpaid.
tax-bot: Awaiting VAT cert from customer. If valid OSS/MT exempt, we'll issue corrected invoice and refund VAT portion (~$1,120).
Marco: Reconciliation complete: we processed both jobs (both created separate outputs) -> billing stands. However, we see server retried one job internally due to a storage ACK timeout and charged it twice. Recommend one-time goodwill credit of $2,750 to resolve quickly.
Zoe: Offer: $2,750 goodwill credit + correct VAT if they provide cert + payment plan 20% now, 40% at 30d, 40% at 60d + signed addendum. Collections to pause hold once $ paid and doc signed.
Luis: Sending plan doc + invoice link to customer now. Requesting payment confirmation and VAT cert upload.
Tanya: On call: customer accepted the goodwill credit and agreed to send VAT cert. They started payment process and expect authorization within 1 hour.
collections-bot: Payment received: partial payment $1,800 for INV-5299 at 2025679099. Invoice status set to On Payment Plan.
Pri: Doc signed via e-sign and uploaded to legal share. I'll keep a copy.
tax-bot: VAT cert received and validated. Issuing corrected invoice; VAT refund note queued.
Zoe: Thanks team. Collections mark as On Payment Plan and monitor upcoming due dates. Marco, please create a tech ticket to investigate internal retry handling to avoid this class of double-charge.
Marco: Filed TICKET-6229 "storage-ack-timeout causes duplicate billing" assigned to eng-runtime. ETA triage tomorrow.
Luis: Will monitor payments and reopen thread if any misses. Closing for now unless something pops up.
